card.statement:
Let $\mathscr{C}$ be an abelian $\mathbf{k}$ -linear category, let $C$ be a $\mathbf{k}$ -coalgebra, and let $F:\mathscr{C}\to{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{C}$ be a $\mathbf{k}$ -linear exact faithful functor. If $B$ is the coalgebra provided by Theorem 2.4 (for the functor given by the composition of $F$ with the forgetful functor ${\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{C}\to{\mathord{\mathrm{Vect}}}_{\mathbf{k}}$ ) and $\overline{F}:\mathscr{C}\xrightarrow{\sim}{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{B}$ the corresponding equivalence, then there exists a unique morphism of $\mathbf{k}$ -coalgebras $f:B\to C$ such that the following diagram commutes:

$\textstyle{\mathscr{C}\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces}$ $\scriptstyle{\overline{F}}$ $\scriptstyle{F}$ $\textstyle{{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{B}\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces}$ $\scriptstyle{f_{*}}$ $\textstyle{{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{C}.}$

Let $B$ and $C$ be two $\mathbf{k}$ -coalgebras. Any $\mathbf{k}$ -linear functor $F:{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{B}\to{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{C}$ such that

$\textstyle{{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{B}\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces}$ $\scriptstyle{F}$ $\scriptstyle{{\mathord{\mathrm{forget}}}}$ $\textstyle{{\mathop{\mathrm{Comod}}}_{C}\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces\ignorespaces}$ $\scriptstyle{{\mathord{\mathrm{forget}}}}$ $\textstyle{{\mathord{\mathrm{Vect}}}_{\mathbf{k}}}$

commutes is of the form $F=f_{*}\,$ for a unique morphism of coalgebras $f:B\to C$.
card.label: Proposition 2.6

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
